content:
Families visiting Nuevo Laredo's municipal cemeteries for Día de Muertos praised the cleanliness, maintenance and organization they found there, according to CML Noticias.

Ahead of the November 2 commemoration, the municipal government carried out weeding, trash removal, cleaning of common areas and conditioning of access points, especially after recent rains caused weed growth, CML Noticias reported. The work covered the Panteón Municipal Antiguo on Viaducto Yucatán and Panteón Municipal Number 2 in the Enrique Cárdenas González sector.

Residents who visited told CML Noticias they found the cemeteries clean, well organized and easier to walk through, and noted the presence of Civil Protection personnel. During the day, Civil Protection staff assisted at entrances and circulation areas to help pedestrian and vehicle traffic move in an orderly way.

El Diario de Nuevo Laredo also reported families recognizing the cleanliness and order in the municipal cemeteries during Día de Muertos.
